target_api: of_count_phandle_with_args / kcalloc (allocation/lookup functions that return a value indicating success or failure)
post_operation: assign error code (e.g. ret = -ENOMEM, ret = -ENOENT) before goto end / return
path_conditions: After a failure check on target_api result (count==0 or kcalloc==NULL), code does goto end without setting ret, so the function returns the previous (possibly 0/success) value of ret instead of a proper negative errno.
